title: RuTutorDial-70: Russian tutoring dialogues with gold rubric labels and a pipeline for verifiable reliability evaluation of LLM judges
description: Corpus of 70 Russian-language tutoring dialogues (35 clean, 35 with controlled defect injection) with reconciled gold labels of two independent annotators on a five-criterion pedagogical rubric; parallel English/Russian MathDial subset; raw logs of all 33 025 judge-call records (8 LLM judges, 3 repeats, including an interleaved control run); code that reproduces every table of the accompanying paper with one command. Data: CC BY-SA 4.0 (inherited from MathDial); code: MIT.
